eyebrow: Search for Common Ground · Imagine If year-end campaign · Campaign video, script Version 1
title: Imagine If:
headline: Search's year-end campaign film, Version 1: open on division, turn to common ground, end on a matched gift.
story: The world tells us it runs on sides. Search for Common Ground asks a different question: what becomes possible when we find common ground?

Three voices from the field (Emmanuel, Hélène, Pesh: audio clips under B-roll) and three small stories (a rumor stopped, a fight over resources turned into a shared system, a woman trusted to lead) show it working.
It starts with one person, then ten, then a community. The close is the client's own gift-match line, read by the VO.
do: Build it from the Version 1 script and its VO recording (Audio Message.m4a).
Fast, disorienting cuts at the open, then slow down on warm faces.
Wide group shots under the three voice clips. Let each clip breathe.
Speed the montage up on “one person… then ten”.
End on Chase's horizontal Imagine If bumper.
dont: No logo, wordmark or title card at 0:00.
Don't change a word of the VO or the clips. Cut only the two lifts this plan names.
No generic stock for the three stories. If a story has no footage, flag it on the item.
Nobody on screen under a voice clip who could be taken for the speaker.
No freeze frames, no animation mid-video, no second aspect ratio.

decisions.t: Is Audio Message.m4a the final VO?
decisions.b: A female read of the whole Version 1 script (3 Nov) is on Drive in _to_delete/sfcg imagine. This plan cuts to it. It differs from the script in four places: “asked us”, “our team works”, “the end of the sentence”, and a doubled “stronger” (lift the first). Nick or Atdhe confirms it is Search's VO, or Search re-reads those lines.
No footage of a rumor being stopped or of a shared resource system is on our drives. Atdhe gets it from Search, or the row stays on the dialogue B-roll and the item says so.
The script has none, and the three voices are audio only, so viewers will not know who speaks. Add a small super (first name and country) only if Yana asks.
Chase's horizontal Imagine If bumper is on Slack (Reference column), not in the page's end card folder yet. The Motion graphics tab shows the Search logo card with sfcg.org/imagine-if as a stand-in.

transcript:
VO recording and voice clips for this cut. Machine transcripts (Whisper, word level) made for this page from the Drive files, because none was on Drive. Times are mm:ss.s in each file. Check every line by ear. The voice clips are audio only.
--- Audio Message.m4a ---
[00:00.4] We're told the world runs on sides, us or them, win or lose, right or wrong.
[00:04.9] But what if that was never actually true?
[00:07.2] For more than 40 years, Search for Common Ground has asked us a different question.
[00:11.6] Not who's right, not who wins.
[00:13.4] But what becomes possible when we find common ground?
[00:16.7] Imagine if we chose each other.
[00:18.5] A rumor stopped before it became violence.
[00:21.4] A fight over scarce resources that became a system neighbors built together.
[00:26.1] A woman previously overlooked finally trusted to lead her community.
[00:30.6] Across the globe, our team works alongside communities in conflict, building the skills and the trust it takes to handle conflict differently.
[00:39.5] It starts with one person, someone with the courage to imagine something different is possible.
[00:45.9] Then 10, then a whole community.
[00:48.4] Turning conflict into something stronger that makes it stronger.
[00:53.0] Imagine a future where conflict is the first word of the story, not the end of the sentence.
[00:59.6] A future in which together we are the authors of a more beautiful world.
[01:04.9] A world strong enough to hold its differences instead of being torn apart by them.
[01:10.3] That world starts with people like you.
[01:13.3] Right now, your gift is matched dollar for dollar, up to $100,000.
[01:18.1] So that's all this. [do not use: talk after the read]

[00:24.6] I am always amazed by the resilience of these young people in the communities that they are working with and the communities that they are coming from.
[00:32.0] Seeing people who once lived in conflict use this dialogue, they decide to trust each other, they decide to collaborate among themselves.
[00:40.7] It reminds me that lasting peace is possible.

[00:00.0] I am always imagining new options, new ideas to bring people together, to make them feel better, be in a better place and to overcome their differences.
